meta.title: Trust in the police
meta.question: How much do Poles trust the police?
meta.measure: Average trust in the police, from 0 (no trust at all) to 10 (complete trust)
meta.anchor: Pooled from every question on trust or confidence in the police, with every answer placed on 0 to 10 and the trend read on the scale of an average question.

items.wording: How much confidence do you have in the police?
items.notes: EVS, 1990, 1999, 2008, 2017 (4 surveys). 'A great deal / quite a lot / not very much / none at all'.

items.wording: Trust in the police
items.notes: CDCEE, January 1991 and March 2000. 'Totally / to a certain point / little / not at all'.

items.wording: Confidence in the police (full / moderate / none)
items.notes: PGSS 1992, 1993, 1994, 1995, 1997, 1999 (6 surveys); 'pełne / umiarkowane / nie mam zaufania'. Version x of the battery: asked of everyone 1992-95, of a random half (split ballot with version y) in 1997 and 1999.

items.wording: Does the activity of the police serve society well? (institutions battery)
items.notes: CBOS, 1990-1997 (the institutions battery that preceded the ratings; as CBOS_GOV_SERVES in Government support).

items.wording: How much confidence do you have in the police?
items.notes: WVS Poland, 1989, 1997, 2005, 2012 (4 surveys). 'A great deal / quite a lot / not very much / none at all'.

items.wording: Does the police deserve trust? (definitely deserves ... definitely does not)
items.notes: PGSS 1997, 1999, 2002, 2005, 2008, 2010 (6 surveys); 'zdecydowanie zasługuje na zaufanie ... zdecydowanie nie zasługuje', midpoint 'ani ... ani'. Version y of the battery: random half of the sample in 1997, 1999 and 2002, everyone from 2005.

items.wording: How would you rate the activity of the police? Good (10) or bad (0)
items.notes: CBOS's ratings of institutions (Oceny działalności instytucji), about twice a year from 1997; microdata to 2017, CBOS's reports 2018-2026, which print only good/bad/don't know, so coded so in both. A rating of performance, not trust: it follows the institution's record and, for elected bodies, the majority of the day (the party breakdown's government term).

items.wording: To what degree do you trust the police? (1 complete trust ... 5 complete lack of trust)
items.notes: CBOS, 2000-11 (APiW 126), 1 survey. 'Do jakiego stopnia darzy Pan(i) zaufaniem', 1 = complete trust ... 5 = complete lack of trust.

items.wording: Trust in the police
items.notes: PGSW 2001 and 2005. 'Trust very much / rather trust / rather distrust / completely distrust'.

items.wording: Do you tend to trust or not to trust the police?
items.notes: Candidate Countries Eurobarometer 2001.1, 2002.2, 2003.2, 2003.4, 2004.1 (5 surveys). 'Tend to trust / tend not to trust'.

items.wording: Do you, generally speaking, trust the police? (definitely ... definitely not)
items.notes: CBOS, 2002-01, 2004-01, 2006-01, 2008-01, 2010-01, 2012-01, 2014-03, 2016-01 (8 surveys). CBOS biennial trust battery ('Czy, ogólnie rzecz biorąc, ma Pan(i) zaufanie, czy też nie ma Pan(i) zaufania, do ...'), four answers plus 'trudno powiedzieć'. Labels vary: '... - X' (2002, 2004, 2010-16), 'zaufanie do K) X' (2006-01), 'zaufanie do X' (2008-01). In 2014 the battery was split across APiW 284 (January) and 286 (March).

items.wording: To what degree does the police inspire your trust? (1 no trust ... 7 great trust)
items.notes: CBOS, 2002-09 (APiW 148), 1 survey. 1 = no trust ... 7 = great trust.

items.wording: Trust in the police (0 no trust at all ... 10 complete trust)
items.notes: ESS Poland, rounds 1-11 (2002-2023), 11 surveys. Round 10 (2021-22) was self-completion; the pipeline's MODE_SPLITS makes it a question of its own.

items.wording: Do you trust the police? (definitely yes ... definitely no)
items.notes: CBOS, 2004-09, 2006-12 (2 surveys). One-off CBOS trust questions answered 'zdecydowanie tak ... zdecydowanie nie' (not the 'mam zaufanie' battery).

items.wording: Do you tend to trust or not to trust the police?
items.notes: Standard/EP Eurobarometer, 2004-2008, 2010 and 2014-2026, 28 surveys (none 2011-13). 'Tend to trust / tend not to trust', DK outside the scale.

items.wording: Trust in the police on an 11-point scale (1 complete lack of trust ... 11 full trust)
items.notes: CBOS, 2008-07 (APiW 218), 1 survey. 11-point card, 1 = complete lack of trust ... 11 = full trust (intermediate codes unlabelled).

items.wording: How much trust do you have in the police? (very much / average / not much / none)
items.notes: CBOS, 2009-04 (APiW 227), 1 survey. 'Bardzo dużym / średnim / niezbyt dużym / żadnym': the scale is not symmetric (no 'large' step), placed linearly.

items.wording: How would you rate the activity of the police? Good (10) or bad (0)
items.notes: CBOS's mixed-mode surveys (CAPI, CATI or CAWI, the respondent's choice) from APiW 359 (May-June 2020), so a question of its own.

items.wording: Trust in the police (0 no trust at all ... 10 complete trust)
items.notes: ESS round 10 (2021-22): self-completion by web and paper in Poland, where every other round was face to face, so a question of its own.

items.wording: Do you, generally speaking, trust the police? (definitely ... definitely not)
items.notes: CBOS's mixed-mode surveys (CAPI, CATI or CAWI, the respondent's choice) from APiW 359 (May-June 2020), so a question of its own.
